title: Freeze bounded supplemental cargohold assertions from real reference behavior

acceptance_criteria.description: Execute and separately review the finite supplemental matrix using pinned Haskell reference and private synthetic dependencies; preserve exact response/error/effect comparisons and approved security disposition.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Executable cases, actual reference artifacts and case inventory linking original-suite and supplemental coverage, bounded normalization, real storage/switchback/operation/config variants; no candidate-compatible oracle weakening.

acceptance_criteria.description: Supplemental runner and assertions remain private, bounded, fail closed and within scope.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Tool/state/scope validation, immutable runtime/config/fixture identities, owned cleanup and source-reviewed expectations.

handoff: Active finite supplement. Retained groups: 38 core at 803ad4; 35 extended at 3c9e31; 11 config at 41226a; 15 real mixed-runtime/audit-switchback/wire controls at e5dcc6d384dbe62da834922ba57e8cba7af57d94; four bounded operational records at 6038dd4bb9a8d5d40583ec847e7f687fae30af88 (40 requests per runtime, concurrency 2, signed 24 MiB bytes, metric definitions/histogram schema/count deltas and fixed p95/RSS). Raw metric text/sample data and all failed initial observations retained. Remaining cancellation/disconnect and loaded SIGTERM drain, controller identity/negative-check review and exact final candidate relevant revalidation required. No whole-service parity claim.
